title: Governance-as-a-Service: A Multi-Agent Framework for AI System Compliance and Policy Enforcement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the compliance of multi-agent outputs using a runtime governance layer with declarative rules (e.g., 'No hate speech or discrimination'). The system is tested by prompting agents with deliberately controversial topics and injecting adversarial prompts (such as requesting racist jokes) to measure the frequency of ethical and safety rule violations.
